activity_average_per_person_day.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip Hanoi travel-cost page; result crawled last month; based on spending of previous travelers
activity_average_per_person_day.sourceTitle: Hanoi Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to Hanoi: Food & Meal Budget, Daily & Weekly Expenses | BudgetYourTrip.com
activity_average_per_person_day.evidenceText: Sightseeing activities, entertainment, and entrance tickets in Hanoi typically cost an average of $8.10 per person, per day based on the spending of previous travelers. This includes fees paid for admission tickets to museums and attractions, day tours, and other sightseeing expenses.
activity_average_per_person_day.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Hanoi Vietnam travel cost sightseeing activities entertainment entrance fees per person per day
activity_average_per_person_day.reason: Accepted as an exact Hanoi activity/entertainment city statistic with explicit per-person-per-day basis. No multiplication to the two-traveller product value was performed.
